issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) specifies post-0.1 item R025 and no open bead covers it, yet post-0.1 items R028/R034/R038/R040 are all in flight. Extend the dependency model from the §3.4 two-kind set to include a declared `verifies` kind; diagnose an inverted verification gate (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) and report it in doctor/list output — advisory only, never rejected at insert time, and never inferred from issue titles. Decide and test how the third kind interacts with §3.4 cycle rejection and computed readiness so a deliberate 'prove the baseline green first' gate is not flagged as an error. Document the kind in `bead schema explain`/the field guide, and add atomicity, concurrency, and diagnosis-accuracy conformance tests (exact-positive diagnosis, zero false positives on ordinary titles containing verification nouns).

Created by: weave strand

issue.description:
ADR-005 names an unresolved drawback of the doctor ready_frontier warning: there is no way to mark an open issue's assignee as deliberately parked, so a legitimate reservation warns on every run and trains operators to ignore the warning. Add an auditable, public-CLI way to flag an assignment as intentionally held (actor-attributed mutation and audit event), exclude only flagged assignments from the ready_frontier warning while keeping them excluded from the claim frontier exactly as today, round-trip the flag through checkpoint import/export, document it in the field guide, and test that unflagged assignments still warn with the exact remedy.

issue.description:
ADR-002 requires that agent-guided rehydration produce a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, recording the source repository and commit — but the report has no defined format, no validation, and no tool support, and ADR-002's own drawbacks note large repositories need batching, resumability, and duplicate detection. No open bead covers this. Work: specify a versioned report shape, add a read-only validator command that checks report completeness against a source inventory without accepting the report as store input, and document batching/resume behavior for large repositories.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Define a validated reconciliation-report contract for agent-guided rehydration
